content: Timoti
Bade Paulos Dorbi šohorot aišše, hentu Lystra šohorot giye. Ar so, heṛe Timoti name ekzon biššaši aššil. Hite aššilde ekzon biššaši Ihudi mayafuwar fuwa, ar baf aššilde Girik zat.
Lystra edde Ikuniyar biššaši báiboinain okkole Timotir babute bala nam gorito.
Paulose Timotire fũwati loi zaito sail buli hitare azomi goraiye, kiyollahoile heṛe ze Ihudi okkol takito hitara zanito Timotir baf ekzon Girik zatide hiyan.
Bade hitara šohore šohore giye edde Zeruzalemor asab okkol edde he murubbi okkole ze hokum okkol dil hitara hin manuš okkolore zanaiye. Ar he niyom okkol falon goitto hoiye.
Ei bafe zomator manuš okkol biššaše mojbut oiye edde hitarar dol din din bari za šuru goijje.
Paulosore Makeḍoniyat ḍaker
Pak Ruhuye hitarare Ešia dešot kalam tobolig gorito no de, hetolla hitara Forugiya edde Galatiya deš bai giye.
Hitara Mysiyar hãsa hãsi fõsi, hentu Bitúniya zaito kušiš goijje, kintu Isar Ruhuye hitarare zaito no de.
Toi hitara Mysiya bai lamat Troasot aišše.
Raitta Paulose ek deha fail, hibaye dekedde, ekzon Makeḍuniyar manuš aiyore tiyaiye edde foriyad gori ḍaki hodde: "Makeḍuniyat aiyore ãrare modot goro!"
Paulose ei deha fai bade ãra Makeḍuniyat zaibolla hehon tiyar oilam, kiyollahoile ãra buzi faijjilam ze Allaye ãrare heṛe kušir hóbor tobolig goribolla ḍaker.
Bade ãra doriyar fõte Troasottu uzu siri Samotrak, tarforor din Neofolisot fõsilam.
Henttu Filifit maze gilam, hiyan Makeḍuniyar he elehar mein šohor edde Romiyo okkolor koloni, he šohorot ãra hoddin takilam.
Ar dórmor din ãra šohoror baire doriyar farot gilam, ar ãra mone goijjilam heṛe munazator zaga ase. Ãra heṛe boilam edde heṛe ek dol mayafuwain dola oiyede hitara loi hota hoilam.

Ar hitarar butore Tuwatira šohoror Ludiya name ek allawala maya fuwa aššil. Hibaye baiyonna rongor horor beboša gorito. Hibaye ãrar hota funnil. Malike hibar dil kuli dil zene hibaye Paulosor hotat diyan de.

Hiba edde hibar góror manuš okkol beggune torikotor gusol loiye. Bade hibaye ãrare foriyad gori hodde: "Õnora zodi ãre Malikor name biššaši boli mone goro, toile ãr górot ai takogai." Ei hota hoiyore hibaye ãrare ata ati gori dori ṭani hibar gorot loigiye.
Paulus edde Silas ziyolot
Ek din ãra he munazator zagat zaidde šomot, ekzon bandir loi deha oilam zattu ek ruh aššil, ziyan loi hibaye goni farito. Hibaye gonafora loi hibar malik okkololla beši ṭiya hamaiye.
Hibaye Paulos edde ãrar fise fise aiššil edde guzori hoil: "Ei manuš itara Šorbo šoktiwala Allar gulam okkol, itara tũwarare nazator fõt zanai dedde."

Hibaye bout din foijjonto endilla gorat takil. Kintu Paulose ar bordaš gori no fari muk firai he ruhure hodde: "Ãi Isa Mosir name hokum dir, hibar butottu niyoli zagoi." Henot hehon hiba hibattu niyoli giyegoi.
Kintu hibar malik okkole, lafor aša ar nai deki Paulos edde Silasore dori bazarot šorharor hãse ṭani loigiye.
Hitara itarare Romiyo bisarhar okkolor munttu loizaiyore hodde: "Ei manuš okkole ãrar šohorot beši gonḍogul sirišti gorer.
Itara Ihudi, ar ãra Romiyo. Ãrar riti niti mozin zin falon gora mana, itara hin tobolig gorer."
Henot oinno manuš okkole o hitarar berudde giye. Ar bisarhar okkole hitarar gar hoor siri felaito edde bet maribolla hokum diye.
Toi hitarare beša beši mar dor gori bade ziyolot golai eijje. Ar hitarare bala gori fahara dibolla ziyolarore hokum diye.
Endilla hokum faiyore ziyolare hitarare beši butoror kamerat loigiye edde kundat maze ṭeng ãṭkai eijje.
Kintu ada raitta Paulos edde Silas Allar hãse munazat edde šukuriya gan goijjil edde hodi okkole hin õl gori funnil.
Hetunot atikka ḍõr busal oil, en ki ziyolhanar meṛi udda hafi uṭṭil, ar hannasun šomosto doroza okkol kuligilgoi edde har hodi okkolor band kuligilgoi.
Henot ziyolar gumottu seton oil edde ziyolor dorozagun kula deki, toluwar loi hite hitar nizor zan nize loibolla bebosta loiye. Kiyollahoile hite hodi okkol dai giyegoi boli mone goijje.
Kintu Paulose guzori ḍak mari hodde, "Oh, nizor hoti no goris, kiyollahoile ãra beggun eṛe asi."
Hetunot he ziyolare serag ani hoi hite dũri butore giye, edde beša beši ḍore hafite hafite Paulos edde Silasor ṭengor sarme foijje.
Toi hite hitarare hentu baire niyolai ainne edde fusar goredde, "Sahab okkol, uddar faibolla ãttu ki gora foribo?"
Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Tũi Malik Isare biššaš goro, toi tũi edde tũwar gór ṭiyaye uddar faiba."
Bade hitara hitare edde hitar góror manuš beggunore Malikor kalam hoiye.
Ar he raitta ziyolare hitarare hitar fũwati loigiye edde hitarar haṛa sira gá okkolore duiye. Ar hite edde hitar góror manuš beggune hehon torikotor gusol loiye.
Tarfore ziyolare hitarare góror butore loigiye edde hitarar sarme hána fani ani diye. Hite edde góror manuš beggune Allare biššaš gori faijjede hiyanor uwore hitara beggune beši kuši oiye.
Bade din zehon oiye, bisarhar okkole ziyolaror hãse endilla hokum loi ofisar okkolore defeṛaiye: "Ei manuš okkolore erido."
Toi ziyolare ei hóbor Paulosore diyegoi edde hodde: "Bisarhar okkole õnorare eri dito hokum diye. Õnora ehon niyoli aiyo, aramor sãte zogoi."

Hetunot Paulose hodde: "Ãra Romor nagorik oi bade ãrar bisar no gori, beainna mainšor šaikkat ãrare bet mara oiye edde ziyolot diya oiye. Ar ehon ãrare gufone bair gori dito sadde neki? Hen oi no fare. Hitara nize aiyok edde ãrare bair gori loi zok."
Toi ofisar okkole ei hóbor bisarhar okkolore zanaiyegoi. Itara Romor nagorikde zani fariyore ḍoraiye.
Toi bisarhar okkole aiyore Paulos edde Silasottu maf saiye edde hitarare ziyolottu baire niyolai loigiye, ar šohor sari zaibolla foriyad goijje.
Hitara ziyolhanattu niyoli ai bade Ludiyar górot giye. Heṛe torikotor báiboinain okkol loi deha goijje edde hitarare tuwajjo di bade henttu giyegoi.
